annotation.justification: The target clause provides a clear exception to the general rule for the ":path" pseudo-header field in the case of an OPTIONS request for an "http" or "https" URI without a path component. It explicitly states that such requests MUST include a ":path" field with a value of '*'. The reference to Section 3.2.4 of [HTTP11] supports this requirement and does not introduce ambiguity. There is no conflicting or unclear language that would allow for multiple reasonable interpretations.
